description: Red Hill Truffles (Mornington Peninsula's first truffle producer) offers guided public truffle hunts throughout winter. Options: Truffle Hunt & Pizza ($189pp; 3hrs); Truffle Hunt x Max's Restaurant at Red Hill Estate ($217pp; includes 2-course lunch); Truffle Hunt & Gourmet Lunch at The Epicurean Red Hill ($195pp); Private Hunts (from $120pp; min $1,200). Périgord black truffle season late May–August. Family packages available.
priceRange: AUD 120–217+pp (options vary; pizza hunt from $189; private from $120pp min $1,200)
suitableFor: Adults and families (under 12 pricing available); foodies
weatherDependency: Outdoor hunt — wear warm waterproof clothes and closed shoes
nearbyAttractions: Polperro Winery; Red Hill Estate (Max's Restaurant); The Epicurean Red Hill
suggestedItineraryPairing: Pair truffle hunt with Max's Restaurant lunch at Red Hill Estate; follow with cellar door visit at Polperro
internalNotes: Périgord (winter) season late May–August; Bianchetto August–September. Summer truffle season also available Nov–Feb. Book well in advance as hunts sell out.
